collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two villagers use a long hooked pole to bring down ripe breadfruit.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two villagers use a long hooked pole to bring down ripe breadfruit. The breadfruit thumps down beside a sleeping pig, which wakes and trots off in protest.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two villagers use a long hooked pole to bring down ripe breadfruit. They argue cheerfully about which one is the ripest.

e1__fx.name: Ending 1
e1__fx.text: Two villagers use a long hooked pole to bring down ripe breadfruit. The first breadfruit lands right in the waiting basket.

e4__fx.text: Two villagers use a long hooked pole to bring down ripe breadfruit. By the end, they have more breadfruit than they can carry.
